node.title: DLI ell=2 weight-5 relations excluded by the complete norm-gcd certificate
node.statement: For every official q<2^256 with v_2(q-1)>=41 and every exact order-1024 root omega in F_q, no reduced signed weight-5 polynomial P satisfies P(omega)=P(omega^3)=0. The pair-quadratic router has exactly 1,514 odd-dilation pair orbits. Every supporting q divides the gcd of the two cleared cyclotomic norms for one orbit; the 507 distinct nontrivial gcds factor over 168 Pocklington-certified primes, with maximum v_2(p-1)=18. Hence the residual WCL slot (ell,w)=(2,5) is empty on every official row.
